checks: Start with 25 credits and one scrap coil; selling/buying/selling scrap and buying a flask transfers one unit each with the expected balances.
Insufficient funds and overselling leave credits, inventory and success counters unchanged.
An exact-price purchase can spend the wallet down to zero; a subsequent purchase fails atomically.
Unknown, prototype and non-finite IDs fail safely; snapshots/catalogue are immutable and sessions are independent.
1,000 deterministic varied trades preserve whole nonnegative balances, single-unit transfers, unrelated items and success-only counters.
All seven original dialogue nodes have exactly two unique choices, valid links, a close action and correct speakers; only Mira opens the shop.
note: Pure source-model checks only; browser interactions and UI accessibility are separate acceptance checks.
